title: Ikea’s colorful donut-shaped smart lamp is $20 off
summary: With its playful design, versatility, and relatively affordable price, the Ikea Varmblixt quickly became one of my colleague Jennifer Pattison Tuohy’s new favorite smart light products when she tested it in April.
